member.name: T:GAF.AppLogger
member.summary: Monthly rotating file logger. One file per month (GAF_yyyy-MM.log) written to the executable directory. Built-in StreamWriter — no external dependencies. Thread-safe via SyncLock. Logging never throws to the caller.

member.name: T:GAF.Stock
member.summary: Stock/inventory service. Manages the item catalog (Artigos) and per-item deliveries to clients (Entregas). Follows the same ByRef Message error pattern as the Utentes service. All DB access uses local Using-scoped connections.

member.name: T:GAF.Notas
